moments.text: Night phone video, portrait: one small blue-white point of light near the centre of a dark sky, blurred lit shapes along the bottom edge.
The camera shakes: the light smears into short streaks and lit shapes rise into the bottom of the frame.
A fainter second point appears just below the light and stays with it for about 7 seconds.
A blue glow, then grey haze, spreads up from the lower right; the point of light stays near the centre.
The point of light changes colour: green, then red-pink, then white. Tiny: zoom in.
Bright white light floods up from the bottom edge, a red glow appears lower left; the point of light holds its place above.
Two white lights side by side enter at the top-left edge and cross the top of the frame left→right in about 1.5 s.
The background turns black and the light shows as a larger, bright white dot.
The light shrinks back to a small point, flickering blue, green and white against a black sky.
Two faint lights side by side enter at the top-left edge, drift right along the top and leave over the top edge near mid-frame.
An orange-white glare with red lights rises in the lower right, then fades; the point of light stays above it.
The camera tilts down: the light streaks upward and blurred lit shapes with a small red light fill the bottom as the clip ends.

notes: No stored crop; ffmpeg cropdetect on this dark portrait clip picks a 78x256 sliver (78:256:530:824), so moment_sheets' auto-crop is wrong here. Reviewed uncropped. Do not store that crop. Full-frame recheck: the 61.1 s 'streaks' are a pair of lights crossing the top edge 59.9-61.4 s; added a second faint pair 92-95.1 s.
